command:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=d1d7b9ec21d2d8e4bcb293559c5133013455c882
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller agent-control
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/20260902-stage27c-sd-power-gate-v1.py | python3
.venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp || true
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
git diff --check
git add scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
git commit -m 'Enable CrowPanel SD power gate'
NEW_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "[AGENT_PROGRESS] sd_power_gate_sha=$NEW_SHA"
bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh clean
GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA="$NEW_SHA" bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build
grep -q "GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA:STRING=$NEW_SHA" build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/CMakeCache.txt
grep -q -- '-DGROWBOX_SD_POWER_GPIO=42' build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/compile_commands.json
test -f build/idf-stage27c-crowpanel/growbox_ml_controller.bin
git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
test -z "$(git status --short)"
echo "PUBLISHED_SHA=$NEW_SHA"
